newsitem.title: USA: United Video terminates Pelmorex stake.
newsitem.headline: United Video terminates Pelmorex stake.

text.p: United Video Satellite Group said on Friday it had terminated its proposed 50 percent economic interest in Pelmorex Inc.
Pelmorex is a Canadian company that distributes multimedia weather information services.
The company said in a statement that Pelmorex received an unsolicited offer from Landmark Communications, which operates The Weather Channel in the United States.
Lawrence Flinn, Jr., chairman and chief executive of UVSG, said, "We decided that it would be fiscally irresponsible, and not in the best interest of our shareholders, to compete with that offer.
"We're disappointed we weren't able to complete the transaction as previously announced."
